description: BFM Benchmark evaluates humanoid whole-body motion-tracking policies under unified physics protocols (Nominal v2 baseline and Sim2Real-P0 real-world hardware alignment). Policies run in isolated worker processes with per-step PD recomputation and independent trace verification.
scoring_summary: Policies are evaluated per protocol without cross-protocol averaging. Failure rules follow SuperMimic Appendix A: root height error > 0.25 m or projected unit-gravity Z error > 0.8 (end-effector deviation is not a failure condition). We report Success Rate, Mean Completion, Full/Prefix XY-aligned MPBPE (mm), XY+Yaw MPBPE (mm), and Joint MAE (rad).

protocols.label: 1. Nominal Baseline (v2)
protocols.desc: Ground friction 1.0 · zero control delay · joint damping 0 / frictionloss 0 · static torque clamping.

protocols.label: 2. Sim2Real-P0 Stress (v1)
protocols.desc: Ground friction 0.4 · 10 ms closed-loop delay · joint damping 0.2 · Coulomb friction 0.1 · 21-joint linear back-EMF envelope.

news.text: Expanded Roban S17 BFM leaderboard from 5 to 13 policies across Nominal v2 and Sim2Real-P0 (adding zl_20261126_partymimic_hoi_vclip20_120000 [tied #1 on LAFAN1-77 P0 at 46/77], partymimic_hoi_terrain_vclip20_120000 [54/62 Sustained P0], zl_20261123_partymimic_tq3e5_120000, zl_20261124_merge_def, zl_20261125_ballhand_loco, zl_20261124_terrain_ball, zl_20261123_blinkmimic_v20_dual, and zl_20261123_blinkmimic_feetair) and published the separated 62-clip flat-ground 4-dimension 7-metric rescore view.

Aligned BFM leaderboard with the official policy registry (Roban S17 21-DoF LAFAN1-77 5 policies × 2 protocols + single-clip onboarding suite), updated CLI verification examples, and switched protocol/suite metadata to dynamic manifest rendering.
Published Roban S17 LAFAN1 (77 clips, 50 Hz) full leaderboard for 5 policies across Nominal v2 and Sim2Real-P0 stress protocols with trace_consistent verification.
Completed Sim2Real-P0 stress evaluations (friction 0.4, 10 ms delay, damping 0.2, Coulomb friction 0.1, 21-joint back-EMF) for syh_20261123_roban_sparse4 and 4 ZL PartyMimic variants.
Integrated BFM track into BFM BenchMark | Leaderboard 0.1 with Protocol v2 documentation and suite views.
Added Roban S17 21-DoF MJCF profile, single-clip validation suite, and PartyMimic / Sparse4 adapters.
